title: 第851章 张扬出手三战三第850章 族内禁地危机来临
content_zh:
第851章张扬出手，三战三
苏玉平连布三层防御。
仅仅片刻，就被尽数摧毁。
他施展了一套剑阵，尽数被破。
黑龙咆哮出击，也被重伤七寸，彻底失去了战力。
无奈之下，苏玉平只得使用自己的本命法宝，一把祖传的黑魔刀。
这一番打击，将天空打成了龙卷风，黑压压之中，夹着电闪雷鸣。
苏玉平接连使用数件法宝，而严永歌由始至终只用一把黑纹长枪。
又斗了片刻，苏玉平开始不支，被打得连连后退。
下方黑魔族人群，脸上尽是担心之色，众人都看得出来，再这样下去，族长必输无疑。
“别浪费时间了，郭槐，取棺。”
魔族大统领看了片刻，就开始对身边的军师下令。
“是。”
郭槐拱了拱手，倏然化成一道白光，朝禁制射去。
“拦住他。”
苏蓝枝一声令下，一众元婴修士，纷纷上前阻拦。
郭槐黑扇一张，无数的细小暗器射出，一声闷哼声传来，带着惊吼。
“针上有毒。”
话音刚落，那中针之人就扑通倒地。
周围众人，脸色微微大变，赶紧回防。

可郭槐的暗器无形无声，神识弱者，根本难以察觉，片刻之后又有几名元婴初期倒地。
苏蓝枝又惊又怒，此时郭槐已经落到禁制前，用力一掌。
也不晓得他用了什么样的神通，防御力极为恐怖的禁制，竟然被一掌击破，让人大跌眼镜。
“再挣扎，死的人会更多。”
郭槐警告一声，在众人失神之际，朝禁地入口遁去。
倏然，一道红光闪过，瞬间挡在他面前。
“找死。”
郭槐轻飘飘一掌拍出，看似柔弱无力，只有他清楚这一掌的力道有多恐怖！
来人身上血光大盛，右拳轰出，血色拳芒瞬间将郭槐震飞上半空。
“袖中藏宝，真够阴险的。”
张扬看了眼被魔焰缠绕的右手，轻轻一挥，就将魔焰甩掉。
“你是何人？”半空之上，郭槐的瞳孔一缩。
content_en:
Chapter 851 Zhang Yang takes action, three against three
Su Yuping deployed three layers of defense.
In just a moment, they were all destroyed.
He used a sword formation and all of them were destroyed.
The black dragon roared and attacked, but was seriously injured by seven inches and completely lost its fighting power.
In desperation, Su Yuping had to use his own magic weapon, an ancestral black magic knife.
This blow turned the sky into a tornado, filled with darkness, filled with lightning and thunder.
Su Yuping used several magic weapons one after another, while Yan Yongge only used a black patterned spear from beginning to end.
After fighting for a while, Su Yuping began to lose control and was beaten back repeatedly.
The faces of the Black Demon clan below were full of worry. Everyone could see that if this continued, the clan leader would definitely lose.
"Don't waste time, Guo Huai, get the coffin."
The demon leader looked at it for a moment and then began to give orders to the military advisors around him.
"Yes."
Guo Huai cupped his hand, and suddenly it turned into a white light and shot towards the restriction.
"Stop him."
Su Lanzhi gave an order, and all the Nascent Soul cultivators stepped forward to stop him.
Guo Huai opened his black fan, and countless small hidden weapons were shot out. A muffled sound came, accompanied by a startled roar.
"The needle is poisonous."
As soon as he finished speaking, the person who had been hit by the needle fell to the ground.
The faces of everyone around him changed slightly, and they quickly returned to defense.
But Guo Huai's hidden weapon was invisible and silent, and it was difficult for those with weak spiritual consciousness to detect it. A moment later, several more early Yuanyings fell to the ground.
Su Lanzhi was shocked and angry. At this time, Guo Huai had already fallen in front of the restraint and struck out with force.
I don't know what kind of magical power he used. The extremely defensive restriction was broken by a palm, which was shocking.
"If we continue to struggle, more people will die."
Guo Huai warned, and when everyone was distracted, he fled towards the entrance of the forbidden area.
Suddenly, a red light flashed and stood in front of him.
"Seeking death."
Guo Huai struck out with a light palm, seemingly weak and weak, but only he knew how terrifying the power of this palm was!
The person's body was filled with blood, and he punched out with his right fist. The bloody fist instantly knocked Guo Huai flying into the air.
"The treasure hidden in the sleeve is really insidious."
Zhang Yang glanced at his right hand that was entangled in the demonic flames, and flicked it away with a wave of his hand.
"Who are you?" Guo Huai's pupils shrank in mid-air.
